unit.can_do_en: Can order simple items, ask the price, and say thanks.

situation_en: In the same café, Daniel asks for a tea and a bun. He asks how much it is. The barista, Emma, says the price in whole euros, a number from 1 to 20. Daniel pays and says here you go as he hands over the money. They both say thanks, and Emma wishes him a good day.

speakers.name: Daniel
speakers.role_en: a customer buying a tea and a bun
